descriptions.text: Rev-Up Toilet-Grade Moonshine. Type: Accelerant. Effect: Highly flammable liquid. Explosive fumes. Status: Will not activate until introduced to flame. At 180 proof, this moonshine will take the hair off your chest and then put it back on. The Rev-Up version is distilled using two types of sugars: the slime trails left behind by the passage of the Brindle Grub, and a secretive, proprietary source. Created exclusively on the dungeon's second floor by the Rev-Up company, jugs of this concoction are highly sought after by the drinking establishments that populate the third, sixth, ninth, twelfth, fifteenth, and eighteenth floors. …

beats.headline: Twenty-five clay jugs
beats.text: Donut loots the dead clurichaun consultants: each of them has a clay jug of something called toilet-grade moonshine. Over the next hour she finds a pamphlet, Rev-Up, promising the benefits of becoming a Rev-Up Moonshine Consultant, see Krakaren or one of her downline consultants. By the time they stop to think they have twenty-five jugs. The description says they are valuable and sought after on deeper floors. Donut is sure the Desperado Club will buy them all and make them rich. Carl grins and asks whether she has any extra torches.

beats.headline: A third of a glass
beats.text: With the boss's tentacles breaking through the walls, Carl pulls a glass smoothie container into his right hand and a jug of unaltered moonshine into his left, pulls the cork with his teeth and fills the glass a third of the way, to a little line on the side. A tentacle bursts in overhead and moonshine sloshes out; he pours a little more, then throws the jug toward the entrance, where it shatters. The rest of the recipe is a dead fairy.

beats.headline: Three bottles for a suitcase
beats.text: Mordecai sends Carl a private note, and two bottles of Rev-Up Moonshine appear on Quint's table. Carl has been using them quite a bit in battle, but he kept a stash to sell, and besides these two he still has twenty-three. Quint sniffs one: that Krakaren bitch said no more was being made this season. Mordecai says Carl and Donut are why it was shut down, and they have the last of it, which isn't exactly true. Make it four, says Quint. Three, says Donut, half asleep, and the potion to stop the world being wavy. Deal: a starter kit, a chest of chemicals and herbs.

beats.headline: Worth more plain
beats.text: At the Silk Road, Carl puts one of his boom jugs on Pustule's table and asks what she'd give him for it. She examines it, says nice design, rubs the bottle, whimpers, and licks it. Then she snaps back to business. His material cost is much too high: a different accelerant would burn less hot and cost ninety percent less, and the plain bottles of moonshine, sold as they are, would be worth much more. She'd sell the jug for about 7,500 gold and offer him half. He keeps it.
